x-description: Proof of work in their own photos. `grid` = square tiles (2–6, captions optional); `before-after` = two 4:3 frames labelled Before / After (Foundry). Slots with no usable photo render as tinted placeholders; a Gallery with no photos at all still reads as finished, so include it only when the profile has at least one usable photo or the composition asks for it.

placeholders.description: grid only: number of empty tiles to draw when `images` is short (default 4 total)
